_about: DEVELOPMENT set for policy retrieval. Used to choose the similarity cutoff in Phase 4. Written by the same author as the two fictional policies, so it is easier than real user questions. The held-out set for the Phase 6 evaluation report must be a different file and must not be used for tuning.
